name: cli
description: InstaWP CLI - Create and manage WordPress sites from the terminal

paragraphs: Create and manage WordPress sites from the terminal.
This installs the latest release. The CLI checks for updates once a day and instawp upgrade keeps you current (see Updating).
Beta — early release. Report issues at github.com/InstaWP/cli/issues.
features: 🤖 Give an AI agent a real WordPress, then ship it — Claude Code / Cursor gets a genuine WP sandbox (WASM PHP + SQLite, zero setup), builds against it, and deploys to a live site:
🌉 Run WP-CLI on any site — no SSH — pipes WP-CLI over HTTPS, so it works behind firewalls and in CI, addressed by name:
🛟 Snapshot before risky changes, roll back in one command — restorable site versions (files + DB), in-place:
💻 Clone a live site to your laptop and back — DB export → SQLite → URL rewrite → file sync, all automatic:
⚙️ Throwaway preview sites in CI — spin one up per PR and tear it down:

whatItDoes.text: Create and manage WordPress sites from the terminal.
